methods.name: GeoState
methods.description: A view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation.

methods.name: Scene Tokenizer
methods.description: A component of GeoState that aggregates multi-view Geometry Foundation Model (GFM) features into a view-decoupled scene state.

methods.name: Geometry Decoder
methods.description: A component of GeoState that queries the scene state using camera rays to reconstruct depth.

methods.name: Autoregressive World Model
methods.description: A component of GeoState that predicts future scene states using a sliding four-state context.

methods.name: Camera Prediction Model
methods.description: An optional model that predicts future camera trajectories, modeled separately from scene state prediction in GeoState.

methods.name: VGGT-Ω
methods.description: A Geometry Foundation Model (GFM) used as a frozen backbone by GeoState to extract geometry-aware features.

methods.name: VGGT-World
methods.description: A prior 3D world model that forecasts future VGGT features.

methods.name: FR3D
methods.description: A prior 3D world model that predicts the latent state of a pretrained 3D reconstruction model while modeling ego-motion separately.

methods.name: Perceiver-style Tokenizer
methods.description: An architecture used by the Scene Tokenizer for aggregating variable-length memory into a fixed-length scene state.

methods.name: Masked Factorized Transformer
methods.description: The architecture adopted by GeoState's Autoregressive World Model for scene-state prediction.

datasets.name: Waymo
datasets.description: A large-scale dataset of dynamic driving scenes used for in-domain evaluation of GeoState.

datasets.name: KITTI
datasets.description: A driving dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation of GeoState.

datasets.name: nuScenes
datasets.description: A driving dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation of GeoState.

metrics.name: depth forecasting
metrics.description: The task of predicting future depth maps, used for evaluating 3D world models.

metrics.name: mean absolute log-depth error (Llog D)
metrics.description: A metric used to measure the accuracy of depth reconstruction.

metrics.name: local depth gradients (Lgrad)
metrics.description: A metric used to supervise local depth gradients during geometry-state learning.

concepts.name: View-decoupled geometry state
concepts.description: The core concept of GeoState, a representation where scene geometry is explicitly separated from camera-dependent observation.

concepts.name: Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs)
concepts.description: Models that provide strong pretrained priors for multi-view 3D perception by learning rich geometric representations.

concepts.name: View dependence
concepts.description: A limitation of GFM features where changes in camera viewpoint induce substantial changes in the representation even when the underlying physical scene remains unchanged.

concepts.name: Scene state
concepts.description: A compact, fixed-length representation of the underlying 3D scene geometry.

concepts.name: Geometric consistency
concepts.description: The property of maintaining accurate and coherent 3D structure across different viewpoints or over time.

concepts.name: Zero-shot generalization
concepts.description: The ability of a model to perform well on new, unseen datasets without requiring additional training.

concepts.name: Scene gauge
concepts.description: A consistent scale maintained throughout temporal prediction and geometry decoding in GeoState.

findings.name: GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo in depth forecasting across all reported horizons.
GeoState supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying.
GeoState generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes.
GeoState maintains a consistent scale throughout the forecasting rollout without per-frame scale alignment.
View decoupling makes the scene representation more predictable.
Viewpoint coupling in GFM features is a limitation when using them as predictive world states.
